description.value: The Chase & District Museum & Archives is a non-profit community museum and archives that has preserved Shuswap regional history since 1987, surviving a 2011 fire and rebuilding under the motto 'From the Ashes.' It occupies a single-story accessible building and houses rotating exhibits, a historic Laviolette Cabin, archival photograph collections, and a gift shop stocked entirely by local artisans. Touring cyclists passing through Chase will find it a welcoming cultural stop, with admission by donation and engaging monthly scavenger hunts for all ages.
